ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT having an address at 25 Bridge Street, New York, NY 10004 (hereinafter referred to as "Owner") and RISINGSAM STONE STREET, a New York Limited Liability Company having an address at 420 Great Neck Road, GzAr Necx, NY 11021 (hereinafter referred to as "Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owneris the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements located thereon, in the County of New York, City and State of New York, known as and by the street address 25 Bridge Street, tax lot Block 10, Lot 19 and more particularly described in Schedule A annexed hereto and made a part of hereof (said land and tax lot being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Building"; and said land State of New York, known as and by the street address 8/12 Stone Street (alsoknown as 27/29 Bridge Street) and the tax lot Block 10, of Lot 33 and more particularly described referred to herein as "Developer's Land"; WHEREAS, Developer proposes to demolish the existing improvements on Developer's Land and replace said improvements with a new building, said new buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as (the "New Building"), said Developer's Land and the New Building being hereinafter referred to as "Developer's Property"); WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the New Building will contain more floor area (herein referred to as "Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of NewYork effective December15,1961,as amended from time to time(the Zoning Resolution") than is now available for use under the "floor area ratio" limitation contained within the Zoning Resolution if Developer's Land was considered as a Exhibit C - Page 1

WHEREAS, there exists approximately 16,731 square feet of Floor Area Development Rights which are appurtenant to the Owner's Land and which are not utilized by the Owner's Building, and Owner desires to make such Excess Floor Area Development Rights (as defined herein) available for use on the Developer's Property and within New Building pursuant to the Zoning Resolution; As used in this Agreement, the term"Floor Area Development Rights" shall mean the rights, as determined in accordance with the Zoning Resolution, appurtenant to a zoninglot,to developsuchzoninglot byerecting thereon a structureor structureswith determined by (i) multiplying the area of such zoning lot by the basic maximum allowable floor area ratio for structures in the zoning district in which such zoning lot is located, and (i) the inclusion of any available bonus floor area and any use, bulk, density and other development rights permitted under the Zoning Resolution which (the"City");and WHEREAS, the Developer desires to acquire and utilize on Developer's Property and to the terms and conditions herein and infurtherance thereof Owner and Developer shall each execute this Agreement and cause all other parties-in-interest in the Combined Zoning Lot (as herein defined) to either execute the Declaration, or waive their rights to do so, and subordinate their respective interest in the Combined Zoning LottothisAgreement; As used in this Agreement, the term"Excess Floor Area Development Rights"shall mean (i) the Floor Area Development Rights appurtenant to Owner's Land as of the date hereof including any and all development rights resulting from a validly enacted appurtenant to Owner's Land less (i) the Retained Floor Area Development Rights, which Retained Floor Area Development Rights are defined as a quantity of 7,461 squarefeet ofFloorAreaDevelopment Rights;and WHEREAS, Owner is willing to convey to Developer the Excess Floor Area Development Rights and permit Developer to utilize the Excess Floor Area Development Rights within Developer's New Building on the terms and conditions hereinafter set forth for the consideration set forth herein, it being understood and agreed, however, that Owner shall retain for Owner's own benefit all Floor Area Exhibit C-Page 2
